core_question: What is the largest land animal in the world? (secondary: What is the chemical formula for common table salt?)
answer_summary: Answer must identify the African elephant (African bush elephant) as the largest living land animal.; after the topic shift: Correct answer is NaCl (sodium chloride), the chemical compound of table salt.
persona: tired and blunt; using casual slang
